root_idea.summary: A root orientation toward firmness, hardness, toughness, and solidity.
root_idea.development: The lexical family applies this orientation to hard, pebbly terrain and a strongly built constitution, while also including the goat-kind and specialized verbal developments connected with goats and earnestness.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran attests مَعْزٌ as an independently lexicalized collective noun meaning goats.

senses.definition: Goats; the goat kind, distinct from wool-bearing sheep.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a collective or quasi-plural noun. The Quranic occurrence is in the expression “of the goats, two.”

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing or of the ground.
A transitive verbal construction in which goats are set apart from sheep.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become abundant in goats; for goats to become numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be said of a man or a people whose goats become numerous, or of the goats themselves.
These forms serve as singular designations corresponding to the collective or quasi-plural مَعْزٌ, including designations for a male or female goat.
An adjectival description of a man's robust constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A possessor or master of goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person characterized by possession or keeping of goats.
A concrete material sense distinct from the animal designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hard, rugged, stony, or pebble-abundant ground; a place of this kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: أَمْعَزُ is applied to a place and مَعْزَاءُ to land or ground; the terms may also be used substantively for rugged terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gathered herd of gazelles or mountain-goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical descriptions vary as to whether the term applies to gazelles, mountain-goats, or both, and whether the herd begins at thirty or at a larger number.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become earnest or serious in an affair; to apply oneself resolutely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an affair or undertaking as its object of seriousness.
